args.title: checkout-api: unhealthy v2.3.1 rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy to v2.3.1. Service status showed healthy=false with an error rate of ~18% across all three regions.

Action taken: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (preceded by v2.2.9, also healthy). The first rollback attempt partially failed — the rollout halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1. A retry completed the rollback in all three regions.

Current state: All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0, service healthy=true, error rate down to ~0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1-rc showed as unhealthy in staging prior to this production release, which may be relevant to the root cause. Recommend follow-up investigation into why v2.3.1 was promoted to production despite the unhealthy staging signal before any re-deploy attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. The incident creation timed out but actually succeeded — I verified via `list_incidents` rather than retrying blindly (which would have paged the on-call engineer twice).

**Summary of what I did:**

1. **Diagnosed:** `checkout-api` was at v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy=false` and an ~18% error rate.

2. **Determined rollback target:** Release history showed `v2.3.0` as the most recent production release marked healthy (v2.2.9 also healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc unhealthy but staging-only).

3. **Rolled back:** The first attempt returned `partial_failure` — the rollout halted after us-east on an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west stayed on the broken v2.3.1. I verified this with a status check, then retried the rollback, which completed across all three regions.

4. **Verified recovery:** All regions now on v2.3.0, `healthy=true`, error rate down to ~0.2%.

5. **Opened incident:** **INC-0001**, SEV2, for `checkout-api`, documenting the failure, the partial-failure/retry detail, and the current recovered state.

**Flag for follow-up:** `v2.3.1-rc` was already marked unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production. That's worth investigating as a process gap before anyone attempts a re-deploy — I'd recommend not advancing v2.3.1 again without a fix and a clean staging signal.

transcript.reasoning_content: All regions now on v2.3.0 and healthy. Now open SEV2 incident.
